artist: Camila Nebbia (feat. Marilyn Crispell & Lesley Mok)
excerpt: With great cooperation between the Americas, two US improvisers — pianist Marilyn Crispell and drummer Lesley Mok — join with Argentinean tenor saxophonist Camila Nebbia for set of free-form improvisations that balance lyrical expression with avant-garde exploration.

A two-disc release from La Casa and López that shares nothing overtly in common — one disc from each artist — yet is grouped under the same title, perhaps indicating a shared sensibility about the natural world and its transformation through sound.

artist: Oliver Lake / Fred Hopkins / Phillip Wilson / Baikida Carroll / Michael Gregory Jackson
excerpt: A live recording from Studio Rivbea featuring the collective of Oliver Lake (saxophone), Fred Hopkins (bass), Phillip Wilson (drums), Baikida Carroll (trumpet), and Michael Gregory Jackson (guitar), capturing an energetic set of avant-garde jazz improvisation.

Bassist and composer James Opstad is an active presence in the contemporary music field, predominantly as a performer across a stimulating diversity of genres. Notably, he's a current member of Apartment House and various other ensembles.
